name: Terah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Haran begat Lot and died before his father Terah in Ur of the Chaldees. Ur means fire in the etymology, and the Chaldees is Babylon; Abram was born and called out of that area.

note.label: Genesis 11: Babel and the Separation of the Nations

points: Abram and Nahor took them wives; Sarai was barren; and Terah took Abram, Lot, and Sarai and went forth from Ur toward Canaan. No attraction language, and what follows immediately is that they moved to another country and she did not buck. You marry a whole family: father-in-law, daughter-in-law, nephew, and all the risk and hardship shared.

note.label: Marriage Beyond Romance: From Eden to Modern Confusion

points: The history begins on the other side of the flood: your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah the father of Abraham and the father of Nachor, and they served other gods.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve
